text: In my opinion, languages, maths and science are the most important, because they give students basic skills for almost any career. However, I think subjects like history and literature are also essential, because they teach us to think critically and understand other people. I wouldn't remove any subject completely, but I'd make the programme more flexible, so students can spend more time on what they are good at.

tips.en: Three subjects show the position at once.
tips.example: In my opinion, languages, maths and science are the most important

tips.en: Wouldn't … but I'd proposes a soft solution.

tips.ru: Wouldn't … but I'd предлагает мягкое решение.

text: I think so, at least in the last two years of school. Teenagers are more motivated when they study something that interests them, and they are likely to get better results. The risk is that some students might choose only easy subjects, so there should be some compulsory ones like maths and a foreign language. A good compromise would be to combine basic subjects with a few optional courses.

text: Marks are important to some extent, because universities and employers use them to compare candidates. However, I don't think they show the whole picture. Some people are very clever but get nervous in exams, while others can memorise a lot without understanding it. Personally, I believe that curiosity and practical skills matter more in the long run than a perfect report card.

tips.en: To some extent admits partial importance.

tips.ru: To some extent признаёт частичную важность.
tips.example: Marks are important to some extent

tips.en: While contrasts two types of people.

text: I doubt it. With technology developing so fast, I expect that a lot of learning will happen online or with the help of artificial intelligence, which can adapt to each student's level. Teachers will probably become more like mentors than people who just give information. Having said that, I think schools will still be necessary, because children need to socialise and learn to work in a team.

tips.en: I doubt it is a natural short answer to a prediction.

tips.ru: I doubt it — естественный краткий ответ на прогноз.
